Question Choices: Four independent trials each succeed with probability 0.20. What is the probability of at least one success?
Hints: Use the complement that all four trials fail;Each failure has probability 0.80;Subtract 0.80^4 from 1
Solution: The probability of four failures is $0.80^4=0.4096$.;Therefore the probability of at least one success is $1-0.4096=0.5904$.

Question Choices: Assuming 365 equally likely birthdays and no leap day, what is the probability that at least two people in a group of 20 share a birthday? Round to four decimal places.
Hints: Use the complement that all 20 birthdays are different;Multiply the factors 365/365 through 346/365;Subtract from 1
Solution: The all-different probability is $\prod_{i=0}^{19}(365-i)/365$.;Thus the probability of at least one shared birthday is $1-\prod_{i=0}^{19}(365-i)/365\approx0.4114$.
